name: Contour Key
description: One hard side key cuts a graphic line across the face and body of the same identity-locked model in every frame, shot against a deep charcoal-black studio cyc rather than a flat mid-grey ground — a coherent campaign, not six different people, with a sharper graphic contrast than a mid-grey ground allows.
lighting: Hard side key, graphic shadow edge on near-black
subject: person
prompt: standing in a three-quarter turn against a deep charcoal-black seamless studio cyc, chest-up to waist-up crop centered in frame, one hard side key light cutting a graphic line down the face and body, the unlit side falling close to true black rather than a lifted grey, poised fashion-plate posture, chin lifted, the hard key rendering skin as real skin: visible pore structure along the lit side, a genuine specular edge where the light grazes the cheekbone, natural fine lines left intact, never smoothed or waxy, finished like a printed fashion editorial rather than a render
